subject: [PATCH] mm/huge_memory: transfer the pmd dirty bit to the folio on zap

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where the pmd dirty bit is not being transferred to the folio when a huge page is zapped, leading to potential silent data loss in certain file systems like xfs. The problem arises because the TLB flush is deferred and can occur after the rmap has been dropped under the pmd lock, causing stale TLB entries to remain. To fix this, the patch aims to transfer the pmd dirty bit to the folio on zap, ensuring that data integrity is maintained even in the presence of concurrent writes.
